Graduate Programmes
Graduate Programmes
NTU offers a diverse range of graduate programmes that combine a holistic educational approach with an innovative framework, fostering hands-on experience and collaborative learning.
Interdisciplinary Graduate Programme
NTU's Interdisciplinary Graduate Programme (IGP) pioneers a new PhD approach, combining multiple disciplines to tackle complex, real-world challenges. This initiative strengthens the university’s research capabilities by uniting faculty across schools and research centres to create new knowledge and develop innovative technologies. It will cement NTU’s strategic plan to strengthen its position as a global leader in research, innovation and education.
Industrial Postgraduate Programme
The Industrial Postgraduate Programme (IPP) is an initiative to build a pool of postgraduate manpower with critical R&D skillsets through training in a corporate R&D environment and local universities.
Global Programmes
The Global Graduate Programmes are developed in collaboration with leading partner universities around the world. They reflect our strong commitment to fostering global academic alliances and advancing research excellence. The programmes are designed to equip students with the skills and knowledge needed to tackle global challenges in a multi-cultural and interconnected world.
Graduate Certificate/FlexiMasters in Blockchain
The Graduate Certificate/FlexiMasters in Blockchain programme is suitable for senior undergraduate students from top universities, fresh graduates, working professionals, and mid-career individuals especially those with a technical background in computer science and computer engineering. It is ideal for those looking to build or strengthen their expertise in blockchain technology and understand how it is applied across industries such as finance, banking, insurance, supply chain, energy, healthcare. Graduates who meet the necessary requirements may continue to pursue the Master of Science in Blockchain for lifelong professional upskilling.
